audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart read a flat "Skill 5/10" on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet levelChart both say Xerath wins every stage except Level 6.
audit.why: Xerath's Q is 750 range, W 1000, E 1050; Annie's Q is 625, W 600 and Summon: Tibbers 600. She has no dash and no gap-closer, so every lane stage below 6 is Xerath's. At 6 a stocked Pyromania plus Flash into Tibbers is an AoE hard stun on an immobile champion.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Xerath, Xerath, Xerath, Xerath, Annie, Xerath, Xerath with whys rewritten to match, matching the content layer's win[0..6] (no win[N] edit needed — content already correct).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes and phases[4]/[5] whys described a generic Xerath curve and did not name Annie's only spike.
audit.why: Annie's power is entirely Level 6 with a charged Pyromania; Xerath retakes it on Luden's plus Zhonya's, which answers the single Tibbers cast.
audit.corrected: Spike prose now names Lost Chapter, Annie's level 6 Flash-Tibbers, and the Luden's + Zhonya's reclaim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable interactions were absent: Annie can cancel Rite of the Arcane with Pyromania or Summon: Tibbers, and Molten Shield absorbs the burst you open with. breakdown.cooldowns also carried no digit.
audit.why: Xerath's R is flagged channel (interruptible — any CC cancels it); Annie's passive and R are both hardCC, and her E is a shield. Real cooldowns: Tibbers 130/115/100, Annie Q 4s, W 7s, E 10s; Xerath E 13/12.5/12/11.5/11.
audit.corrected: breakdown.mid now states the channel cancel; dosFull[1].d states Molten Shield absorbing chip; breakdown.cooldowns now carries the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text wrote "Summon Tibbers" without the colon; packet flagged it as a probable wrong ability name.
21 misgendering defects (Annie called he/his/him) plus two copy-paste-bleed bullets.

audit.corrected: All flagged fields regendered and both bled bullets replaced with bodies that match their titles.

edits.after: - Summon: Tibbers is 130/115/100s — Flash-Tibbers off a stocked Pyromania is her whole threat, so step up only inside that downtime. Her Q is 4s, W 7s, Molten Shield 10s. - Budget Shocking Orb (E, 13s) for her commit, never for chip.
